body: The original public API baseline check on actual UI861 integration source 3baff077 failed because its source-tree hash and semantic output hash were stale. Fresh main 8db0 has no conflicts. No browser/device/native/runtime or package acceptance is inferred from this static projection. Root/825 retains ownership of those checks; no package publication, parent/default push or merge.
